topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: Oh my gosh, I can't even begin to tell you how messed up this whole thing is. Your car, towed right from your driveway? Like, how does something like that even happen? It's just not right. I mean, are you okay? You must be going through so much trying to sort this out. I just can’t believe someone would do that, and for what? It’s not like you were causing any trouble. I really hope you can get it sorted out soon. If you need anything, seriously, anything at all, I’m here for you.
